parameters.name: DefenseScene
parameters.description: The protection scenario. For more information, see the **DefenseScene** parameter in [CreateDefenseRule](~~461421~~).

parameters.name: DefenseSubScene
parameters.description:
The sub-scenario of the protection template. Valid values:
- **web**: BOT management web protection scenario template.
- **app**: BOT management app protection scenario template.
- **basic**: BOT management basic protection template.
- **bot_custom_acl**: BOT management advanced custom rule protection template.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paging query request. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description:
The name of the protected object, protection group, or the ID of the protected asset.

> This parameter is used together with the ResourceType parameter. Both parameters must have values for filtering to take effect.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the protected resource.
> This parameter is used together with the Resource parameter. Both parameters must have values for filtering to take effect.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection template.

parameters.name: TemplateIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the protection templates to query. You can specify this parameter to query the protected resources associated with multiple protection templates. Separate multiple template IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The name of the protection template to query.

parameters.name: TemplateType
parameters.description:
The templatetype of the protection template. Valid values:
- **user_default**: user default protection.
- **user_custom**: user custom protection.
